description: This file defines classes and functions for handling XML schemas related to database structure, including creation, modification, and migration of database schemas using XML descriptions. It includes classes for representing database objects such as tables, indexes, data, and query sets, as well as functions for parsing XML schemas, transforming schemas between versions, and executing associated SQL statements. The file is part of a schema management system within a larger PHP-based project for database schema automation.

classes.name: dbObject
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a generic database object with common properties and methods for handling XML callbacks and platform support.

classes.name: dbTable
classes.description: Represents a database table, including its fields, indexes, options, and methods to generate SQL for creating or dropping the table, and parsing XML schema definitions.

classes.name: dbIndex
classes.description: Represents a database index, capable of generating SQL for creation and supporting options and dropped state.

classes.name: dbData
classes.description: Handles data rows within tables, including parsing XML data segments and generating SQL insert statements.

classes.name: dbQuerySet
classes.description: Represents a set of SQL queries defined in XML, allowing building, prefixing, and executing query sequences.

classes.name: adoSchema
classes.description: Main class for loading, parsing, transforming, and executing database schemas defined in XML. It manages schema versions, conversions, and schema application to a database.

methods.name: ParseSchema
methods.description: Loads an XML schema file, parses it, and generates SQL statements to create the described database schema.

methods.name: ParseSchemaString
methods.description: Parses an XML schema string into SQL statements for database creation or upgrade.

methods.name: ExecuteSchema
methods.description: Executes an array of SQL statements to implement the schema on a database, with options to continue on error.
